boundary_note: Bounded first pass for both frozen records in Operations Against Vicksburg [December 1862-January 1863]. Preserve per-engagement dates: Chickasaw Bayou December 26–29, 1862, and Arkansas Post January 9–11, 1863. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen force field names the Right Wing, XIII Corps, and the Department of Mississippi and East Louisiana; the live field reads zero. Greene gives Sherman's expedition about 32,000 men with 60 guns, says Sherman faced not less than 12,000 Confederates rather than the 6,000-man garrison, and that the brigades bearing the December 29 assault numbered not more than 6,000.
claims.rationale: Expedition, defending-force and assaulting-force figures are different populations; none is adopted as a matched opening strength. Live zeros are not measured absence.

claims.value: The frozen and live results read Confederate victory. NPS and Greene say the December 29 assault was repulsed and Sherman withdrew; Greene says he re-embarked on January 2 and relinquished command to McClernand.
claims.rationale: Retain the original result and engagement interval; later movements and campaign contribution are different measures. No new probabilities or individual causal credit. The re-embarkation and change of command follow the interval.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 1,983 total (US 1,776; CS 207); the live NPS field reads 1963 total (US 1776; CS 187;). Greene gives Union losses of 1,929 (191 killed, 982 wounded, 756 missing) and Confederate losses of 187 (57 killed, 120 wounded, 10 missing) for December 27–29.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Greene's Confederate total matches the live field and differs from the frozen 207.

open_questions: Original returns, Sherman's and Pemberton's reports and casualty reconciliation remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant Union engineer officer, founded on the Official Records. Reports and letters quoted inside Greene are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
